title: Evaluation of VX-433 in Healthy Adults and Adults With Narcolepsy
official: A Phase 1 Study of VX-433 in Healthy Adults and in Adults With Narcolepsy
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics (PK) of single and multiple ascending doses of VX-433, assess its effects on the PK of midazolam, bupropion, and hydroxybupropion in healthy participants as well as to evaluate its effects on excessive daytime sleepiness in subjects with narcolepsy type 1 (NT1).
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

Parts A, B and C

* Female of non-childbearing potential or male between the ages of 18 and 55 years, inclusive
* Body mass index (BMI) of 18.0 to 30.0 kilogram per meter square (kg/m2), inclusive
* A total body weight of more than (\>) 50 kg
* Nonsmoker or ex-smoker for at least 3 months before screening with current nonsmoking status confirmed by urine or blood cotinine at screening

Part D

* Female or male between the ages of 18 and 70 years, inclusive
* Body mass index (BMI) of 18.0 to 40.0 kilogram per meter square (kg/m2), inclusive
* A total body weight of more than (\>) 50 kg
* Diagnosis of NT1
* Documented history of cataplexy per investigator
* At least 6 hours of sleep per night as documented by subject diary with usual bedtime before midnight and wake time before 9:00 in the morning

Key Exclusion Criteria:

Parts A, B and C

* History of febrile illness or other acute illness that has not fully resolved within 14 days before the first dose of study drug
* Any condition possibly affecting drug absorption
* For female participants: of childbearing potential, pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant or donate ova during the study or within 90 days after last dose of study drug

Part D

* Medical disorder, other than NT1, associated with excessive daytime sleep
* History of febrile illness within 5 days before the first dose of study drug
* Any condition possibly affecting drug absorption

Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria will apply.
